art_direction.background_logic: 米白纸面承载八个现场切片，深青色坐标线把它们串成一张可读的发布地图；不使用最近几期的 proof sheet、路线图、钟表或房间平面
art_direction.behance_viewing_arc: 从全球发售的本地时钟开始，进入高山 campaign，再穿过 Vault、黑胶、水瓶、扑克牌，最后回到图书馆和便利店的工作现场

closing_palette.rationale: 深青保留城市现场的厚度，纸白保证阅读，信号黄把第一次真实使用标成入口而不是终点。

art_direction.core_visual_action: 把发布日期改写成坐标：每个故事都把一个抽象的上线动作钉到时间、地点或身体使用上
art_direction.cover_composition: 深青底上八个橙色坐标点沿斜线分布，标题从中段切入；不重用最近三期的闭合线、路线钟表或房间块
art_direction.desktop_interaction_mechanic: 黏附索引只显示故事坐标和章节锚点；正文、来源图、来源清单和故事路由不依赖 JavaScript
art_direction.dominant_mood: 一块挂在城市墙面上的深青色现场地图：准确、亮、留有手写坐标的余温
art_direction.image_behavior: 八张经核验的一手官方图片使用八种裁切比例并点击回到官方来源；源站若阻止热链，位置保留本期自有且明确标注为非纪实的对象图解
art_direction.mobbin_usability_constraint: 所有来源图明确可点击、焦点可见、点击目标至少 44px；无 JavaScript 时全文、来源、图片说明与 Preview 权利提示完整
art_direction.mobile_translation: 地图视觉压缩为纵向坐标条，八个故事全部单列展开；图片保留不同裁切但不制造横向滚动
art_direction.page_density_and_tempo: 封面先给地图，Stüssy 与 LOEWE 快速进入，Prince 与 LA Priest 拉长声音的时间，两个对象把手感压低，香港与 FamilyMart 回到公共日常
art_direction.palette_logic: paper #F4F0E4, ink #111515, deep teal #123B40, green #3E9C91, safety orange #EF5B35, signal yellow #F2D14C
art_direction.quiet_ending: 把现场还给使用者：发布不是终点，是对象第一次被使用的条件
art_direction.type_scale_logic: 封面用宽体大字压住视觉重心，正文保持 18–20px，坐标标签用等宽小字；中文标题在桌面和 390px 移动端都保持短行

editorial_position: 发布不是按下一个按钮就结束；具体的地点、时间、身体姿势或使用规则，决定一个新东西怎样从页面进入生活。
limitations: Daily candidate and non-production Preview input only; this manifest cannot authorize deployment.
Canonical private GUAiZzz/harry-tone main was verified at pinned commit 13cd6b7046bd81be396810d2923f3a5dc818e93f from a fresh ephemeral workspace; no private material enters this repository.

All eight selected stories use externally hosted first-party official images linked to their official origin pages. Reuse rights remain unknown, so production stays blocked; the visible local SVGs are original non-documentary fallback diagrams only.

All five regional lanes, the full 99-subject registry quick scan, the deterministic drop_streetwear cohort, Supreme Thursday, Stüssy daily, luxury runway calendars, exhibitions/programmes and small-object signals were checked. Registry access limits remain disclosed privately and are not treated as evidence.
Named human editorial, visual, cultural-appropriateness and image-rights review is unresolved. No Preview dispatch, merge, Pages deployment or production action is authorized.
